verdict.rationale: Brave ships its own MCP server and agent Skills, so users can drive search, summarization and LLM-context tools from natural-language prompts in clients like Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor. The Answers endpoint also takes natural-language questions and returns grounded answers. However, this works only through third-party AI clients, and natural-language control covers search calls, not operating the product itself (account, keys, plans, configuration). Missing for 10: native natural-language control of the product beyond search queries, natural-language management of account/keys/settings, independent hands-on corroboration of the natural-language agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: An MCP server implementation that integrates the Brave Search API, providing comprehensive search capabilities including web search, local business search, place search, image search, video search, news search, LLM context, and AI-powered summarization.
This guide covers the steps required to enable Brave Search as a tool to be used in the Claude desktop app using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Skills work with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenClaw, Cline, Goose, Amp, Roo Code
Direct AI answers using OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Best for chat interfaces that need instant, grounded AI responses.
